name: What is included in emergency interior storm damage repair?

mainEntity.name: What is included in emergency interior storm damage repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Emergency interior storm damage repair focuses on restoring living spaces after severe weather breaches your roof, siding, or windows. It covers extracting water, removing soaked insulation, tearing out ruined drywall, and repairing damaged structural framing. Restoration also includes replacing interior trim, installing new tile or flooring, repairing ceilings, and completing seamless paint matching. While exterior contractors patch shingles or siding, interior specialists handle structural drying, custom carpentry, finish work, and trade coordination for affected plumbing or electrical components.
acceptedAnswer.description: It includes removing soaked drywall and insulation, drying structural framing, repairing subfloors, and rebuilding walls, trim, tile, and interior paint.
